author: mark
text:
Cross-gate flag from alignment gate bl-f08f: README.md has v0.3.1-stale references that the docs gate should sweep:

1. Lines 342-348: 'v0.3.1 transitional note' explicitly says fs_watcher and
   git_tree haven't been retargeted yet ('will surface stale results until
   v0.3.1 P4 retargets them'). P4 (bl-c22c) is closed; the UI is on the new
   layout. Remove or rewrite the note as a completed migration line.
2. Line 354: per-worktree contents listing includes 'steps/' — that path is
   now a conv-repo-root prefix in the actual fs_watcher
   (crates/lernie-ui-egui/src/fs_watcher/mod.rs:28-35:
   ROOT_CONTROL_PREFIXES = [..., 'steps']; WORKTREE_PREFIXES = without steps).
   Drop 'steps/' from the per-worktree bullet, reflect it on the conv-repo
   control bullet alongside manifest.yaml/etc.
3. Lines 367-368: 'Conversation detection keys off steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/...
   paths introduced by each merge.' — git_tree/detect.rs now parses
   '"Merge branch '<branch>'"' subjects (branch name = conv id, since v0.3
   dropped prefixes); the steps/** diff path is gone. Update to describe
   branch-name detection.

These are README-only; no spec-doc drift behind them. ARCH/PRINCIPLES are
internally consistent on the v0.3.1 contract.

author: mark
text:
v0.3.1 docs gate: drop transitional note + scrub stale steps paths

Closes the v0.3.1 contract regression docs gate by aligning
README.md and two src/ doc-comments with the P1 amendment.

README:
- Drop the "v0.3.1 transitional note" — P4 already retargeted
  fs_watcher and git_tree against the conv-repo-root step layout.
- Move `steps/` from the per-worktree list to the conv-repo root
  list in the fs_watcher description (ROOT_CONTROL_PREFIXES, ARCH
  §2.2 / §2.3).
- Rewrite the git_tree blurb so conversation detection is described
  against the merged branch name (the actual key per detect.rs)
  rather than the merge tree's `steps/` paths (which never land on
  `main` — step records are not committed, §2.3).

src/:
- ToolExecutor::execute: `step_dir` is conv-repo-rooted, not
  worktree-rooted; spell out the §2.2 / §2.3 placement and that the
  step record (request.json / response.json / meta.json) is written
  there at runtime (no longer claimed to ride in the snapshot
  commit).
- StepDir test fixture rustdoc: same correction, with the v0.3.1
  layout label.

Docs-only — no code paths touched. tarpaulin --fail-under 100
green.
